# rms_invitations (Data Source)

Retrieves a list of Teltonika RMS User Invitations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rms_invitations" "all" {}

output "invitation_emails" {
  value = data.rms_invitations.all.invitations[*].email
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The identifier for this data source.
- `invitations` (Attributes List) List of invitations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--invitations))
